prompts.title: Q: Direct syscalls vs indirect syscalls (high level)?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Both aim to **avoid** **user-mode** **detours**; **indirect** tries to **blend** **call** **stacks**-**defenders** use **kernel** **traces** and **anomaly** **models**.
